e: A court-martial orders opposition leader and former Prime Minister Domingos Simões Pereira back to prison, accusing him of involvement in an alleged October 2025 coup attempt.
Opposition leader Domingos Simões Pereira is released from prison after being detained following the 2025 Guinea-Bissau coup d'état in November.
The government suspends a US-backed review of the effects of hepatitis B vaccines on newborns pending an ethics review.
